title: Appeal meh

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
I profoundly remember I did verbally warn you but as I stated before that's me purely being lenient; I apologise however , i should have got confirmation of you actually hearing me ,  if there was in fact a problem on my or your side. Another thing I would like to bring up is sorry for the warn being issued after you logged off , it was due to the steven situation if you had any queries about that.

~Quoting myself from 1st appeal



 The reason we ask you not to report staff is due to the fact that, one, if they were hacking they can just toggle;two it automatically comes across as a joke even if not intended. The best way to report a staff member is to a senior+ , ideally with evidence but not required. 

The warn is valid either way as i told you to stop and you did not, therefore:
  1. "These rules are subject to change without notice. Players are responsible for keeping up with rule changes, it is up to you to keep checking the rule page.
Follow the directions given by any Avicus staff member. If you believe a staff member is abusing their power through wrongful punishments or other methods, please email support@avicus.net and provide any evidence or details you possess regarding the staff member."

So if you think I'm abusing please report me to a higher up.

~Quote end

So the rules I'm referring to are: A1 and A4
The 'staff instruction I'm speaking of is the warn you  have now received , not the verbal warn , as I said, I didn't have to give any verbal warn so it doesn't matter in this situation the fact you didn't hear it. So due to that , the instruction given by a staff member was to stop. So this is a general warn from me as a staff member not to do It , please. If you have any issues with me or that msg an admin.

Also, I would just like to emphasize  this is only a warn no consequences follow due to it.

Appeal Denied
Thanks,
~Pizza

Locking 24 hours from response
(I may leave open longer since this seems to be on-going.)

replies.author: DonaldMyTrump
replies.body:
I don't think you're abusing, I just think you're wrong. I am appealing this despite the no consequences since it adds a negative connotation to me as a person since punishments are made public. In this appeal you apologize twice for the warnings to stop not reaching me (once through TS and once through /warn). Since you clearly agree that I was not properly warned (despite the fact that it is unnecessary I would ask that you keep this fact in mind.

I have no problem following a staff member's instructions but as I said I never heard/saw you say anything to me. From what I can tell that is the only rule I broke since the rule about reporting staff members is clearly in reference to abuse saying "Follow the directions given by any Avicus staff member. If you believe a staff member is abusing their power through wrongful punishments or other methods, please email support@avicus.net and provide any evidence or details you possess regarding the staff member." Please not that it does not say abusing in any form, it says "abusing their power" since hacking is not a staff granted power it was not being abused in this case and would not fall under that rule.

With that in consideration the only rule I am actually on the line for is following staff instructions, instructions which I personally never heard and were only given (according to your testimony). Given that I was not breaking any written rules, that verbal warn becomes very necessary, as without it there is no actual staff instruction to not follow and since you (according to your testimony) "i should have got confirmation of you actually hearing me " you did not actually know that I had heard you when you warned me across platforms (me having taken these actions in-game and you having warned me over TS). However if you consider the warn to be the staff instructions than as you stated they occurred while I was offline and therefore I was unable to receive these instructions, never-mind follow them.

After analyzing the rules I've broken all I see is a rule that specifically talks about reporting staff members for abuse, not hacking and a rule about following staff instructions which by your own testimony I never received. This is I'm sure a large waste of your time for a punishment that as you stated does not have any continuing consequences and I truly do apologize for having to put you through all of this just to get to the bottom of this and clear my name of this. I really would like to sincerely thank you for going through the effort of actually handling the appeal properly and breaking down exactly what happened and what rules were broken. This dedication to not only the rules but also the community's understanding of them is why I continue to say you're one of the better Sr. Mods. If at a point in this appeal I have seemed rude or sarcastic I would like to apologize as I really only have the best views on you and your handling of this.

I would like to request that this punishment be appealed. I would also like to request that no actions be taken against Pizza to discipline him on this as I do believe that this unfortunate event was simply the result of a miscommunication between me and him and had nothing to do with it being either of our's fault.

Thanks.

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
He knows!

But on a serious note, we spoke on slack ; cleared some things up. We will be adding to the rule A4 to stop miss-haps and miscommunication such as this in the future. As for the infraction , it will be completely wiped. I would actually like to thank you for making a network change that will hopefully fix any future issues that may be relatable scenarios such as this.

Another note the rule change will take 1-2 to actually be pushed  so don't expect an instant change.
I would kindly ask you don't report any staff members though in between now and then however.

Infraction wiped/appealed
Thanks,
~Pizza
